name: browser-use
headline: Room - Tab Management for Zellij
short_description: A Zellij plugin for quickly searching and switching tabs. Benefits operations teams by improving workflow efficiency. Connects to Zellij for tab management.
author: rvcas

sections.overview:
Room is a Zellij plugin that streamlines terminal workflow by allowing you to quickly search and switch between tabs without manual counting. Type to filter your tab list by name, then press Enter to switch or use number quick-jump for instant navigation. The plugin supports case-insensitive filtering and integrates with Zellij's keybinding system via a simple configuration. It solves the friction of managing many renamed tabs by replacing the traditional tab-number method with intuitive text search. Power users and operations teams benefit from reduced context-switching time when navigating complex terminal sessions.
Quickly jump to a specific tab by typing its name when managing 10+ tabs
Reduce time spent counting tab numbers in complex Zellij sessions
Enable Claude Code to programmatically focus panes via pipe commands
Navigate tabs without memorizing numeric positions after renaming them
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/rvcas/room`
sections.usage:
```
Use the Zellij [room] plugin to quickly search and switch between tabs in your current session. List all open tabs, then switch to the tab named [TAB_NAME]. If [TAB_NAME] doesn't exist, create a new tab and rename it to [TAB_NAME].
```
Copy

```
```
Current Zellij session tabs:
1. logs (active)
2. editor
3. terminal
4. dashboard

Switching to 'dashboard' tab...

Switched to tab 'dashboard' (ID: 3).

The tab 'dashboard' is now active and ready for use.
```
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
